column1: # Expectations that are correct per the docs but that the current binary does not meet.
# A waiver keeps the assertion live instead of rewriting it to match the code. It must
# cite an open row in docs/conflicts.md, and when the underlying defect is fixed the
# waiver has to go: scripts/test_synthetic_intent.py fails on a waived check that has
# started passing, so a fix cannot silently leave stale waivers behind.
# Remove a row only together with the fix that makes it unnecessary.
